newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bars brokers from trading their own account.
newsitem.headline: Manila bars brokers from trading their own account.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Wednesday it is stopping share traders and brokers from trading on their personal; account following complaints by individual investors.

"In order to assure and maintain a high degree of investor confidence in the stock market, all licensed traders/salesmen are hereby absolutely prohibited from trading in the exchange for their personal accounts, directly or indirectly," SEC chairman Perfecto Yasay said in a statement.
He said violators would be either fined, suspended or have his license revoked.
The employer will also be held responsible for the action of its traders.
"Brokerage firms and their traders/salesmen must first and foremost be concerned about the interests of their customers, not their own personal interests," he added.
A well-known newspaper columnist recently complained that she was defrauded of over seven million pesos by her brokers.
